Reading the workspace

  1. Requirements definition
  2. REQ-G70-US-ID-02

In-car connectivity that stays connected

Proposal
1, implement. Personal eSIM is a large complaint cluster (42 rows, 14 defects) and connected drive / infotainment technology is level A (39 rows, 24 defects); Wi-Fi hotspot (4.51 vs 4.98) and connected services (4.83 vs 5.13) score below the peer. The rear theatre screen depends on it.
Horizon
H1. Backend, carrier integration and software.
Domain
Infotainment & Digital Services
Markets
US
Evidence level
A (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1

Statement

The personal eSIM, Wi-Fi hotspot and connected services shall activate once and stay working with all major US carriers, including business plans, without repeated resets.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USeSIM activation success on first attempt>= 98 % across the four largest US carriersActivation logsassumption
USStudy Wi-Fi hotspot (1-7)>= 5.0 (today 4.51, peer 4.98)Next US customer study waveevidence
